property_summary: For any caller who sends exactly TICKET_AMOUNT to play(), the reference contract always increases (or at least does not decrease) its pot by TICKET_AMOUNT after the call (i.e., pot_new >= pot_old), whereas the mutant that subtracts the ticket amount will make pot decrease for some valid calls, violating this invariant.
change_summary: Replace the pot update to subtract the ticket amount instead of adding it (decrements pot on play).
